decision.thesis: All cash, the forty-second all-cash row and the first decision of week 8 under full caps. The 2026-10-26 feedback page decomposes Monday: one book name significant at 5%, Genting +4.38% at 2.80 sigma (idiosyncratic +5.01%), back to its 10-21 close of 1.43, with no row about the company published on 10-26; the Bursa rights-listing application reported after Friday's close is a title-only candidate the store cannot weigh, and Genting Malaysia rose 3.57% the same day. Every other name moved within normal variation, including Apple -1.10% (1.18 sigma) and Petronas Chemicals -1.72% (0.34 sigma). Press Metal's 2.19-sigma fall on 10-23 is still unexplained. The web evidence step qualified Genting 10-26 and Press Metal 10-23 but searched nothing for want of a key, and finnhub, fmp and fred stopped collecting on 10-27 for the same reason. No name carries a measured, sourced reason to expect it to beat cash over 21 sessions. Seventeen all-cash claims are graded, all correct, against a control at -5.35%. Claim: nothing in the fundable universe beats cash over 21 sessions.
